crossRefs.note: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.
The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez…
The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

parallels.note: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight. So Yahweh killed him.

people.name: Bath-shua
people.line: Judah's Canaanite wife; mother of Er, Onan, and Shelah.

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Er
people.line: Judah's firstborn son, killed by God for his wickedness.

people.name: Shelah
people.line: Judah's youngest son and his descendants

people.name: Shua
people.line: Father of Canaanite wife of Judah, mother of Er, Onan, and Shelah.

translations.web: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah; which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight; and he killed him.
translations.bsb: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death.
translations.kjv: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
translations.asv: The sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah; which three were born unto him of Shua's daughter the Canaanitess. And Er, Judah's first-born, was wicked in the sight of Jehovah; and he slew him.
